LiHua responds empathetically, acknowledging the challenge Wolfgang faces, but also offers encouragement and support, emphasizing Wolfgang's talent and the importance of taking things one step at a time to navigate through the difficult period. They both look forward to the upcoming jam session as a way to relieve some of this tension and enjoy a break from the pressures of work.
